title: Upskilling for the Future of African Enterprise
excerpt: How SEEP expanded from digital literacy into enterprise blockchain development and Web3 innovation.

content.text: Innovation never stands still. When we launched SEEP 2.0: Tech-2-School, our goal was to bridge the digital divide by introducing students to foundational technology pathways.
However, we quickly realized that preparing Africa's future workforce meant mastering the infrastructure of tomorrow.
Through the NITDA Blockchain Scholarship Program, participants were trained in enterprise-grade Web3 infrastructure.

items: Node Systems and distributed ledger architecture.
Identity Management and scripting for smart contracts.

sections.title: Solving Real Nigerian Problems with Web3

items: Blockchain-powered micro-payment platform for market traders affected by cashless policy challenges.
Decentralized e-voting platform for secure and transparent elections.

sections.title: What This Means for SEE Support Centre

content.text: We are expanding beyond digital literacy into building future-ready developers capable of solving Africa's toughest challenges.
The future is decentralized, secure, and locally grown.

title: Tech-2-School: The Genesis of SEEP 2.0 and the Journey to Empower the Next Generation
excerpt: The story behind SEEP 2.0 and how the movement began in public secondary schools.

content.text: Back in 2019, while still an undergraduate, the vision for the Student Entrepreneurial Empowerment Program was born.
By July 2022, that vision evolved into SEEP 2.0: Tech-2-School.

items: Tech-101 Deployment with The Roothub Uyo.

content.text: At AdiahaObong Secondary Commercial School, students participated in sessions on Digital Marketing and Google Search.
Government Technical College students were introduced to design principles and many touched a computer for the first time.
Students explored Design Thinking, Digital Marketing, Photography, and Content Development.
22 students advanced into an intensive 8-week bootcamp through volunteer and partner support.
The seeds have been sown. Now watch us cultivate the future.
